overview_description.description:
GovPredict provides research, analytics, and intelligence for winning public affairs campaigns. Telegraph named GovPredict #1 in Congressional tech in 2018.

The SaaS platform gives public affairs and political professionals access to millions of structured documents that concern federal politics, state politics, and local politics, as well as campaign contributions. An integrated grassroots platform supports advocacy campaigns to influence legislative and regulatory proposals.
 
Existing solutions are bulky. Trying to tie together independent fly-in apps, data solutions and CRM is time consuming.  We’ve brought all of the most important solutions together into a single platform for public affairs campaigns, so you can focus all of your time on what matters.

about_short_description.short_description: Research, analytics, and actionable intelligence for winning public affairs campaigns.

product.name: Legislative Tracking
product.description: Track legislation across Congress, all 50 states, internationally, and the EU. Get real-time alerts, monitor social media conversations, track bills, engage with stakeholders, and report on efforts.

product.name: Grassroots Advocacy
product.description: Design action centers to recruit, educate, and build relationships with advocates. Engage lawmakers with compelling experiences that drive change and highlight success with modern dashboards.

product.name: Stakeholder Management
product.description: A system for tracking interactions and engaging with stakeholders in one place. Save contact information and manage communications efficiently.

product.name: Lawmaker Data
product.description: Access human-verified official, staffer, executive, and agency contacts across government levels. Includes up-to-date contact information and detailed background information.

product.name: PAC Management
product.description: Manage political action committee activities with tools for fundraising, compliance, and reporting. Simplifies workflows and enhances fund-raising efforts.

product.name: Quorum & Axios Partnership
product.description: Integration of Axios Pro’s content within Quorum for enhanced policy news and software solutions. Offers side-by-side policy analysis, in-depth insights, and custom alerts.
